meta.title: Really European? Who controls the products on Europe's buy-European directories
meta.evidence_rule: No row is marked EU-controlled, non-EU-controlled or PE-controlled without a primary document (company register, annual report, regulatory filing, or an acquisition press release by a party to the deal) linked in source_url and a checked_on date. Everything else is control_type=unknown, verdict=unverified.
